notes: AEAT Manual practico IVA 2025, Capitulo 5 'Deducciones y devoluciones', apartado 'Prorrata general', ejemplo de alquiler de viviendas y locales de negocio (paginas 137-138). The manual states the prior-year operations as viviendas 12.000 EUR and locales de negocio 32.000 EUR, yielding a provisional prorrata of 72,72727% rounded up to 73%. It states the current-year operations as viviendas 20.000 EUR and locales 25.000 EUR, yielding a definitive prorrata of 55,5555% rounded up to 56%. It also states supported IVA of 1.280 EUR in the first three quarters and 160 EUR in the fourth quarter. The example's own regularizacion figures are: first-three-quarter deduction at provisional percentage 934,40 EUR; correct first-three-quarter deduction at definitive percentage 716,80 EUR; excess deduction 217,60 EUR; fourth-quarter current deduction 89,60 EUR; fourth-quarter applicable deduction 89,60 - 217,60 = -128,00 EUR as lower deduction or income; annual check 1.440 x 56% = 806,40 EUR. The expected casilla values below are copied from those manual figures: annual total volume 45.000 EUR, annual con-derecho volume 25.000 EUR, definitive prorrata percentage 56, and Modelo 303 casilla 44 standalone regularizacion amount -217,60 EUR. The manual's -128,00 EUR is the net fourth-quarter deduction after adding the current-quarter 89,60 EUR deduction to the standalone regularizacion. No value is derived from the registry formula under test.
